title: One More Night
screen_direction: NILS frame-LEFT facing right, seated at the counter. RAE frame-RIGHT facing left, standing, with the door at 0.90W behind her. Never crossed.

shots.scene: Wide two-shot, night kitchen. He sits at the counter frame left, not looking up; she stands frame right with a bag over one shoulder, facing him, already half-turned toward the door behind her. One pendant lamp is the only bright thing. Slow push-in.
shots.acting: flat delivery, no gesture, already turned half away — she has said this before

shots.scene: Medium on him, her shoulder soft in the foreground right of frame. He keeps his eyes on the counter until 'already', then looks at her.
shots.acting: tired, not angry; gaze lifts on the last word only
shots.notes: his first look at her in the film

shots.scene: Medium on her, his shoulder foreground left. Free hand comes up on 'mean' and the brow lifts on 'it'.
shots.acting: the over-conviction beat — gesture lands on 'mean' (3.32s), brow on 'it' (3.64s)

shots.scene: Insert close on her hand at her side — keys between two fingers, catching the lamp. His eyeline arrives into frame from the right.
shots.acting: no acting at all — the object is the line
shots.notes: prop must be readable at phone size

shots.scene: SILENCE 1.64s. Wide: she crosses to the door at frame right, four footsteps, hand finds the handle, and stops without turning back. He stays seated at frame left. Camera holds, slight drift only.
shots.acting: walk cycle with planted feet and a matching x-speed; the stop has weight
shots.notes: physical action test — walkPose, not a slide

shots.scene: Close on her profile at the door, still facing it. Chin lifts a fraction toward him on the word.
shots.acting: two words, defensive, eyes still on the door — she has not committed to turning

shots.line: Last time you left, you left your keys.
shots.scene: Medium on him, now turned fully toward her. Hands stay flat on the counter. Even lighting on his face, no push.
shots.acting: he states a fact and does not embellish it; this is the line that has to land
shots.notes: delivery must be quiet or the whole scene tips

shots.scene: SILENCE 2.04s — THE TEST. Giant face on her, blurred door behind. Nothing happens for 1.2s. Then the expression turns: brows drop, eyes soften, mouth unclenches. One blink at 9.6s. Camera almost still, 1.02 to 1.04 over the whole shot.
shots.acting: the decision happens on her face with no words and no cut. If this shot fails, the film fails.
shots.notes: expression-turn test — the single most important shot in the pass

shots.scene: Two-shot from the door: she has turned back, half-body, bag still on. She says it while starting to face him properly.
shots.acting: the line is a protest, the body has already begun to concede — they must disagree

shots.line: It's the only one I've got.
shots.scene: Medium on him. He looks away first, down to the counter, on 'only one'.
shots.acting: he admits it; gaze breaks on 'only one' (12.26s)

shots.scene: SILENCE 1.84s — the decision told by an object. Insert on the counter: her hand puts the keys down. They land, and the film FREEZE-FRAMES on the impact — dust and a lamp-mote hang in the air, cool tint, corner badge, slow rings. Then time resumes and her hand withdraws.
shots.acting: no faces at all — the keys decide. Freeze enters on the impact and holds ~0.8s.
shots.notes: signature device test: freeze-frame with particles hanging

shots.scene: Medium on her, bag now off the shoulder and hanging from one hand. She looks at him for the first time since the door.
shots.acting: quieter than her other lines, slightly warm, and she initiates the gaze

shots.scene: Slow pull-out to the wide two-shot from the opening, now with the keys visible on the counter between them. He repeats her words. She almost smiles. End card question rises over the last second.
shots.acting: mirror of s001 with one object changed — the geography now says the opposite thing
shots.notes: bookend; the keys must be readable in frame
